company.name: Teachive
company.shortDescription: Teachive is an innovative EdTech platform that connects students with educators, tutors, coaches, & professionals through e-learning.
company.description: Teachive is a UAE-based educational technology company focused on transforming digital learning through an interactive e-learning and virtual reality (VR) platform. The platform enables students to connect with educators, mentors, and industry professionals for personalized learning, tutoring, coaching, and skill development. Teachive integrates advanced matching technology, digital wallet features, and collaborative learning tools to create an engaging knowledge-sharing ecosystem for Gen Z learners. The company also promotes youth empowerment by enabling educators and freelancers to monetize their expertise while supporting quality education aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform connecting students and tutors for live, interactive educational sessions across various subjects and languages.
productsAndServices.name: Teachive Platform
